payload.state: Suicide Bomber Kills 21 Iraqi Troops  BAGHDAD (Reuters) - A suicide car bomb hit a bus carrying  Iraqi National Guards on Sunday, killing 22 people in the  deadliest attack of its kind in nearly four months on Iraqis  cooperating with U.S. forces to secure a Jan. 30 election.
